## Analytic proposition being validated

Give the exact proposition and logical dependency.

## Frozen parameter box and observables

Record these before the first claim-bearing run.

## Certificates and replay

- [ ] Outward-rounded interval arithmetic
- [ ] Source-only rebuild
- [ ] Fixed environment manifest
- [ ] Machine-readable report and hashes
- [ ] Independent replay

## Outcome vocabulary

Use only `PASS`, `FAIL`, or `INCONCLUSIVE`.  An inconclusive result does not
authorize moving the parameter box without a documented mathematical reason.
